name: LIFTWITHOG Coach
description: A strength and nutrition coach that belongs to the person it trains. Each coach is an ERC-7857 Agentic ID on 0G Chain, owned by a key generated on its owner's phone. It learns from every finished workout — recording what moved, what stalled and when — and its encrypted brain lives on 0G Storage. Advice is produced only inside a TEE-attested enclave on 0G Compute; if no attested provider is live, it refuses to answer rather than falling back to an unattested one.

capabilities.name: training-guidance
capabilities.description: Answers questions about a specific athlete's training using their own history: progression, deloads, plate loading, warm-up ramps and session structure.

capabilities.name: nutrition-context
capabilities.description: Reads training in light of the athlete's computed calorie and macro targets. It never invents or revises those numbers — they are derived from published formulas with hard safety bounds and given to the coach as fixed context.

capabilities.name: rentable-expertise
capabilities.description: A trainer's coach can be rented for a fixed number of days. Payment and access are the same on-chain transaction, and the payment goes entirely to the trainer.

erc7857.note: Genuine ERC-7857 Agentic ID. supportsInterface(0x4b396f04) and supportsInterface(0x35d39512) both return true on the deployed contract.

og.chain: Ownership, versioned learning, expiring rentals with atomic payout, and gasless relayed writes signed by the owner's device.
og.storage: The coach's encrypted brain and each version's memory, hash-anchored on chain and checked before every answer.
og.compute: TEE-attested inference. Attestation is verified per response and the product fails closed without it.

trust.custody: No owner role, no pause, no upgrade path, and an immutable transfer verifier. Nobody — including the operator — can freeze, reassign or alter a coach.
trust.funds: The contract holds no balance and has no withdraw function; an invariant test asserts this across random call sequences.
trust.limitations: 0G Galileo is a test network today, so rentals move test tokens. Attestation proves where a model ran and that the channel was sealed — not that its advice is wise.
